name_en: Zhejiang Province Changxing Silk Co., Ltd.
name_cn: 浙江省长兴丝绸有限公司
main_products: 100% polyester mini matt, satin, bright dazzle, taffeta, net fabric, super poly
woven_evidence: The FOB directory lists woven polyester constructions (mini matt, satin, taffeta) among its main products. Bloomberg says it makes woven, warp-knitted and knitted fabrics.

canton_fair.evidence_note: The Huzhou 137th Canton Fair booth allocation list gives 浙江省长兴丝绸有限公司 4 brand booths in the textile raw materials and fabrics zone.

notes: ExportHub lists it as a warp-knit supplier, so the knit share may be large. Its satin and mini matt fit abaya and lining use.
